RECORD_TYPES.title: RECORD_TYPES
RECORD_TYPES.description: List of comma separated DNS record types to query for.

REMOTE_NS.title: REMOTE_NS
REMOTE_NS.description: The IP address of the DNS resolver you want to use.

DNS_TIMEOUT.title: DNS_TIMEOUT
DNS_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in whole seconds dnspython waits per query attempt to the nameserver. Defaults to 5. When exceeded the boefje reports a timeout.

DNS_LIFETIME.title: DNS_LIFETIME
DNS_LIFETIME.description: Total time in whole seconds dnspython may spend on one resolution, including retries. Defaults to 30. When exceeded the boefje reports a timeout.
